Documentation NOT required, so (a) is vacuous; CONFORMANCE.md has no row and needs none. Behaviour: object ref NULL = CLR null (never references an object); data-pointer/program-pointer/function-pointer NULL = each readonly struct's default, distinct from any real address. Probe: DP initial = NULL, SET DP TO ADDRESS OF X -> NOT = NULL, SET DP TO NULL -> = NULL, NULL=NULL, PP initial NULL. pb557 golden asserts P NOT = NULL after ADDRESS OF (the 'guaranteed not to represent the address of any data item' half). Editions: pointers/object refs introduced 2002.

Rule: 'SEARCH ALL statement (varying of the search index during the search operation). This item is required. The internal procedure employed by the implementor does not have to be documented' (14.9.37 GR9). Documentation NOT required; the required behaviour is GR9's. Code: EmitAllScan sets index=1 (initial setting ignored), probes in order, tests '>= bound' BEFORE '+= 1' so the index never exceeds the last element nor falls below the first; empty table -> unsuccessful with no probe. Golden pb447 asserts A=IN-RANGE (unsuccessful Format 2 stays in 1..5), C=IN-RANGE (ODO current count bound 3), D=03 (success). cite: OK §14.9.37.4 9) 'Its setting is varied during the search operation in a manner specified by the implementor'; OK §14.9.37.4 9) 'At no time is it set to a value that exceeds the value that corresponds to the last element of the table'; OK §A.1 170).
